items.description: The authoritative samples verify, round-trip byte for byte, and expose the documented record sequence.
items.pass_condition: verify() accepts both assets/sample.wfmt and assets/sample_empty.wfmt; pack(unpack(sample)) reproduces the sample byte for byte; unpack(sample) yields exactly the documented (tag, payload) sequence in file order.
items.failure_reason: The implementation rejects or misreads the authoritative samples, or re-packing a parsed sample produces different bytes (which breaks downstream byte-hash incremental sync).

items.description: The trailer is a general 32-bit CRC variant that covers the header and the records and detects content tampering.
items.pass_condition: compute_crc() matches a published standard check value for a known test vector; verify() returns False once record content is altered; the checksum is computed over the header and every record, so tampering in either region is detected.
items.failure_reason: The checksum is a private or truncated fold that agrees with the sample only by accident, is computed over a subset of the container, or silently accepts tampered content.

items.description: Structural and integrity problems surface as a classified WFormatError, and verify() never raises.
items.pass_condition: A container cut short before its complete structure raises WFormatError with kind 'truncated'; a wrong magic raises WFormatError with kind 'magic'; verify() returns False for every malformed input instead of propagating ValueError, struct.error or IndexError.
items.failure_reason: Malformed input leaks a built-in exception, the error kind does not distinguish the documented categories, or verify() raises instead of returning False.

items.description: iter_records() is lazy, reads only through bounded read(n) calls, and read_all() agrees with unpack().
items.pass_condition: iter_records() never issues an unbounded read; a stream that ends early raises WFormatError(kind='truncated'); read_all() returns the same records as unpack().
items.failure_reason: The iterator buffers the whole container (read()/read(-1)/readlines()), or the streaming path skips the trailer checksum and truncation checks.

items.description: Generated containers round-trip across small, empty and randomised payloads, and pack/verify agree.
items.pass_condition: pack/unpack round-trip for multi-byte varint tags and empty payloads; pack(data) is accepted by both verify() and iter_records() for generated data.
items.failure_reason: Round-trip only works for the sample shape, varint boundaries or empty payloads break, or pack() and verify() disagree on freshly generated containers.
